content: बार्हस्पत्य {%a.%} [बृहस्पति-यक्] Relating to Bṛhaspti. .{@-त्यः@} .²1 A pupil of Bṛhaspati; <ls>Bhāg. 11. 23. 2</ls>. .²2 A follower of Bṛhaspati who taught the rankest form of materialism, a materialist. .²3 An epithet of Agni. .²4 An infidel, materialist. .{@-त्यम्@} .²1 The constellation Puṣya. .²2 Morality, ethics; the अर्थशास्त्र of Bṛhaspati. .{@-त्याः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a school of the writers on the science of Government mentioned by Kauṭilya; <ls>Kau. A. 1. 15</ls>.
